text:
Maya: Quick capture from today's onboarding for ClearWave — they flagged two things: (1) need a per-route cost export (CSV) so their FinOps team can map expensive prompts to product features, and (2) a way to mute noisy non-critical alerts during business hours. They mentioned renewal in ~6 weeks and want something before their renew decision.
Jordan: cool — can you paste the exact ask or a short quote from the call?
Maya: Quote: 'We can't show execs token burn by route in one export; engineering asks for a CSV we can hand to finance.' Also: 'The alerts are spamming product owners during daily standups.'
Sam: noting — sounds like both billing/usage (product) and alerting (ops). Could be a renewal risk if unaddressed.
Jordan: Agree. Tagging this as cross-team. For prioritization: if the CSV enables their finance reconciliation and impacts renewal, that's P1; otherwise P2. Ravi, can you give a rough effort estimate for (A) per-route CSV export with token-cost columns, and (B) alert snooze/mute toggle?
Ravi: Roughs: (A) requires adding per-route aggregation endpoint + CSV serializer + a tiny UI download button. If data already aggregated server-side, ~3 dev-weeks; if we need new aggregation pipeline, ~2 sprints. (B) alert snooze toggle (user-level or org-level?) — org-level scheduled quiet hours: ~2 dev-weeks + feature flag.
Lena: Could we ship an interim: export aggregated route metrics (no cost-per-token breakdown) + a manual alert-snooze option, as a staged delivery? That would likely keep them happy for renewal window.
Maya: They explicitly asked for cost numbers, but said an interim aggregated export + promise to ship full cost CSV would be acceptable if we offer them beta access. They offered to be beta testers.
Jordan: OK action items: 1) Ravi to scope quick interim vs full solution and confirm dependencies (data pipeline, precomputed counters). 2) Maya to collect the sample CSV layout from ClearWave and confirm beta participation. 3) Sam to create a productboard entry with CS tag + renewal note. Check-in in 3 business days.
Maya: I uploaded the sample CSV they shared to #uploads (link) and they confirmed beta. :thumbsup:
product-bot: Created productboard item PB-4321 — "Per-route cost export & alert snooze".
Sam: I'll add a renewal-risk flag and estimated impact to PB-4321.
Jordan: Thanks team — let's prioritize the interim path unless Ravi surfaces a blocker.
Maya: Keeping this one hot — will DM updates and escalate if timeline slips.
